name: zutil_zrdr_free_search_path_list
description: zUtil_ZRDR_FreeSearchPathList drains owned search-path payloads and destroys the archive-list container.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zReader/ZRDR source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a5cc0 validates calling zUtil_ZRDR_FreePathList on the supplied list, then zArchiveList_Destroy on the same list, and returning zero.
The native smoke creates a two-entry search-path list, frees it through zUtil_ZRDR_FreeSearchPathList, verifies a zero return, and verifies list nodes return to the ZRDR free pool.
